# P23 (process)
# generated by gen_views.py; sources: elements.jsonl 95570c1f441443df

Members move the room's planning into a chat, an existing server or a new one, and invite helpers to it. They bring the chat's designs, decisions and warnings back to the thread. They argue which chat to use, whether a chat is needed or secure, whether it is official, and whether it may decide for the work or bind placers.
